passRule: Same matter (requests pl-*): A request passes when every hard check holds: an expected yes has probability >= 0.8 (the product's bar for acting on a yes) and an expected no has probability <= 0.799. The set passes when all 8 requests pass. Near misses (same company or same kind of document, another matter) are soft: a miss is reported, never a failure. The note of every check starts with its kind. The two isolations are scored separately: requests pl-same-matter-quote and pl-same-matter-report (one card per question) against pl-*-R# (one card per request). Arrangement (requests ask-*-now): A request passes when every hard check holds. Relevance requests (cN): each clearly relevant excerpt >= 0.6 (the product's bar: it is selected), each clearly irrelevant one <= 0.599. Arrangement requests (cN_now, asked only for the excerpts the relevance answers select, on the date the question is about): each current excerpt >= 0.5 (it is not dropped as dated) and each wrong-time/version excerpt <= 0.499 (HARD: below the bar it is dated and never offered as the current answer). The set passes when all 2 requests pass. Near-miss relevance (<= 0.599) is soft: a miss is reported, never a failure. The note of every check starts with its kind.
